description:
Refactor a portfolio position in JStock by splitting a transaction. You have a single purchase of 100 shares of Apple (AAPL) bought on Jan 15, 2024, at $185.20. Your goal is to split this into two separate lots of 50 shares each to track different strategies.

1. Edit the existing AAPL transaction: Change 'Units' to 50 and set the Comment to 'Long Term Hold'.
2. Add a NEW buy transaction for AAPL: Set Date to 'Jan 15, 2024', Price to 185.20, Units to 50, and Comment to 'Short Term Trade'.

The total share count (100) and cost basis must remain the same.
